limitations: Client geographic location is unverified. HTTP timings include that client's network, TLS, Vercel ingress and deployment protection; they exclude CLI startup and are not authenticated European-user page timings.

Operations use random missing IDs only in the fixed diagnostic collection. No business payload transfer, index fanout, parsing, authentication/revocation, rate-limit write, production API flow, browser rendering or full-page loading is measured.

firstDbUse denotes first SDK use observed by this module, not proven platform cold start. Warm summaries require a prior successful measurement on the same instance, exclude warmup rounds and exclude first database use.
Each CLI curl starts its own client connection. This differs from browser connection reuse. Sequential and parallel read patterns are synthetic; getAll5 is one batch RPC over five missing references.
Eight or ten sampled pairs per mode are indicative. Sample p95 is often the maximum and does not estimate production p95 reliably. Report errors and sample counts, not only medians.
Per-instance request/read budgets are not a global quota across autoscaling instances. The runner is independently bounded and makes no automatic measurement retries.
The earlier metadata-only test reported eur3. This runner does not re-fetch metadata in its timed handlers, so metadata HTTP work cannot contaminate read/handler comparisons.
